rule: Module IFO carries Mod_MinWeatInt (default 0), Mod_MaxWeatInt (default 100), Mod_RainChance (default 0), Mod_SnowChance (default 0). All four are stored and exposed by getters that have no caller in src. Area ambient sound and music are read as day and night pairs with a volume curve 1.25 times (1 minus 5 to the power of minus v over 127); only the day track is played (night branch is a TODO). No weather runtime was found in the engine code read.
keep: Per-zone weather intensity range (min and max) as data
Per-zone rain and snow chance as data
Day and night ambient and music pair per zone
change: The night branch must actually play (donor TODO in music and ambient functions)
The weather fields need a runtime; the donor stores them and never reads them
Indoor zones force rain and snow chance to zero
look_test: None from this donor alone: no weather visual exists in the code read. For sound, play the day and night ambient tracks of one zone on a phone and compare; Lead to place the row. Visual weather direction comes from the exult look test.
